meta.title: Deadlockprohunger — Deadlock analytics & strategy
meta.description: Unofficial community analytics and strategy for Deadlock. Data, insight, decision, action.

hero.intro: A community analytics hub for Deadlock players. Practical data, clear insights and tools built by players, for players.

pulse.title: Deadlock pulse
pulse.description: The few numbers that best describe this week. Open “Why?” for the reasoning.

performance.title: Hero performance
performance.description: Top five heroes this week by win rate, pick rate and recorded bans. Heroes with a Low sample never rank.

heroes.title: Who’s moving
heroes.description: Only changes larger than normal week-to-week variation are called trends. Everything else is “stable” and not listed.

builds.title: Trending builds
builds.description: Most favorited this week. Win rates appear only when enough tracked matches used the build.

matches.title: Recent high-rank matches
matches.description: Newest matches in the top rank band from the last 24 hours.

empty.pulseDescription: No hero has a large enough sample in this window to report.
empty.buildsDescription: No build was favorited this week yet.
empty.matchesTitle: No top-band matches in the last 24 hours
empty.matchesDescription: The data source hasn’t processed any yet.

pulse.sparkline: {hero}’s daily win rate over the window.

trending.title: Most picked
trending.description: Highest pick rate this window, with each hero’s win rate and weekly change.

rising.title: Rising
rising.description: Win rate up vs the previous 7 days, beyond normal variation.

falling.title: Falling
falling.description: Win rate down vs the previous 7 days, beyond normal variation.

trends.none: None this week: no hero moved beyond normal week-to-week variation.
trends.sparkline: {metric} moved from {from} to {to} over the window.

performance.noSample: No hero has a large enough sample in this window.
performance.noBans: No bans were recorded in this window.
performance.bansNote: {count, plural, one {# ban} other {# bans}} recorded in the last 7 days, from matches whose bans were read from the demo. The source doesn’t say how many matches that is, so this shows each hero’s share of recorded bans, not a ban rate.
performance.bansFailed: Ban data didn’t load. Win and pick rates are unaffected.

patch.unknownText: We couldn’t date the latest changelog, so “current patch” windows fall back to the last 7 days.
patch.unknownNote: Statistics below are still real; they just aren’t split at a patch boundary.
patch.excerptNote: Excerpt from the official post’s preview; the full notes are on the forum.
patch.noPreview: The feed doesn’t include a preview of this post. Open it for the notes.
patch.limited: This patch is very recent, so “current patch” views have little post-patch data. Treat trends as early signals.
patch.window: “Current patch” views on this site start on this date (from the changelog title).
patch.newTab: (opens the official forum in a new tab)
